what_this_is: Settings for src/notices.mjs, the notices every AI of one person sees once: how many are kept, what a reader seen for the first time is shown, how many one reply carries, when a reader nobody has shown anything to is forgotten, and the words a decision's notice and a handoff's notices are made of (each handoff row with its next_call, the call that acts on it, {field} filled from the handoff). `shown_without_a_plan` lists the kinds an AI is shown even on a plan that keeps nothing: what Trillion told the person (the held thing reaches their AIs on every plan, as it reaches their page and phone). Changing a limit or a word is a change here, never in code.

waiting.said: Work is waiting for you ({to_agent}): "{job}". Take it with take_work (agent_id "{to_agent}", handoff_id "{handoff_id}"), do it, then finish_work.

waiting_for_anyone.said: Work is waiting for whichever of this person's AIs takes it first: "{job}". If it fits what you do, take it with take_work (your agent_id, handoff_id "{handoff_id}"), do it, then finish_work.

finished.said: {taken_by} finished work you handed off: "{job}". Read the result with read_handoff (handoff_id "{handoff_id}").

stuck.said: {in_the_way_by} is stuck on work you handed off: "{job}". In the way: "{in_the_way}". Read it with read_handoff (handoff_id "{handoff_id}").
